caption: The video captures a first-person view from the bow of a red kayak gliding slowly across a calm, fog-shrouded lake. The red deck, its black bungee straps, and a small central mount fill the lower foreground, with a dark blade-like object protruding just left of the bow. A left bank of tall dark conifers stands mirrored in the still water, and a tree-covered point closes the right side beneath mist-wrapped hills. Over time, the kayak drifts gently forward, the conifers and pale left shoreline looking marginally larger and sliding toward the frame edges. The viewpoint rocks and tilts subtly, the horizon angle and the bow's apparent height wavering as the boat floats. Surface ripples on the right and the tree reflections on the left continuously shift in shape and brightness. The bow and its rigging stay centered throughout, showing the camera is fixed to the moving kayak. The small dark shapes in the open water shift only slightly relative to the bow.
